newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three children die in fire in central France.
newsitem.headline: Three children die in fire in central France.

text.p: Three children aged three to seven died in a fire in a residential building in the central French city Dijon on Sunday, firefighters said.
Police have opened an investigation into the fire's origins, they said.
The children's mother, a friend and the friend's daughter were able to escape from the apartment in which the fire broke out, but were in hospital for treatment of unspecified injuries.
The children were unable to escape from the blaze despite efforts by emergency workers to reach them, firefighters said.
